snippet.title: We Were Here Tomorrow - Official Announcement Trailer | Steam, PlayStation & Xbox
snippet.description:
Two Explorers, one Tomorrow.

We Were Here Tomorrow is coming to PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.
Wishlist Today:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2315050
https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9ncv2h01lht4
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017739

In this next standalone entry of the We Were Here series, you and your partner wake up inside a mysterious facility. Strange machinery surrounds you, and a calm, confident voice guides you through a series of assignments.
Often separated and equipped with different tools, you’ll need to rely on your walkie-talkies to communicate clearly and work together. Each assignment introduces new asymmetrical puzzles that can only be solved through cooperation with your fellow explorer.

#WeWereHere #coop #gaming #puzzlegame 
Visit http://www.totalmayhemgames.com

Looking for a co-op partner? Join the We Were Here discord channel!
https://discord.gg/wewerehereseries

Totally Awesome Merch available at:
http://www.totalmayhemmerch.com

We Were Here Socials:
Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/WeWereHereGame
Reddit: http://www.reddit.com/r/WeWereHere
